name: Sriharikota SLP
best_known_for: India's heavy-lift pad — GSLV Mk III / LVM3 to Chandrayaan-3, Mangalyaan, and the upcoming Gaganyaan crew programme
credit: Second Launch Pad at Satish Dhawan Space Centre on Sriharikota Island, 13.7°N on India's east coast. First flight PSLV-C6 in May 2005; supports both the PSLV and the heavier LVM3 (formerly GSLV Mk III). Lifted Chandrayaan-2 (July 2019), Chandrayaan-3 (July 2023, the successful lunar lander), and is the planned Gaganyaan crew pad for India's first indigenous human spaceflight. First Launch Pad (FLP, ~1990s) sits next door for smaller manifests. Coordinates from ISRO + DGCA records.
